title: AppSec EU15 - Rory Mccune - Security And Modern Software Deployment
summary: Rory McCune's AppSec EU 2015 talk on security risks in modern software deployment. It covers weaknesses in package ecosystems like npm, RubyGems and PyPI, and repository compromise.
why: The speaker and others cite it in threads about malicious packages and typosquatting.

quote.text: I did a talk last year for OWASP AppSecEU that covers this kind of thing.
